seo.title: Parkov Photography | Photographer in Bulgaria
seo.description: Premium bilingual photography website for weddings, portraits, events, products, business, family sessions, and real estate across Bulgaria.

hero.title: Frames that stay with you.
hero.copy: Parkov creates wedding, portrait, event, and commercial photography with a clean visual style, calm communication, and attention to real moments.

portfolio.title: A portfolio with character, not just a gallery.
portfolio.copy: The first version uses sample photography. Then we replace everything with Parkov's real work and organize categories around Bulgarian client demand.

about.title: Calm direction, sharp timing, and photographs made to feel personal.
about.copy: The website is being shaped for a photographer who can handle many kinds of work without feeling generic. The tone should feel local, reliable, and premium for clients in Bulgaria.

faq.title: Questions Bulgarian clients usually ask before booking.

travel.question: Do you travel outside one city?
travel.answer: Yes. The site is planned for Bulgaria-wide work. Travel costs can be included in the final quote depending on the location.

delivery.question: How fast are photos delivered?
delivery.answer: Delivery depends on the shoot type. The final site should show realistic timing for previews and full edited galleries.

deposit.question: Is a deposit required?
deposit.answer: For larger events, a deposit is usually recommended to reserve the date. We will confirm the exact policy with Parkov.

raw.question: Are RAW files included?
raw.answer: Usually clients receive edited final images. RAW delivery can be handled as a separate policy if the owner wants it.

languages.question: Can clients use Bulgarian or English?
languages.answer: Yes. The site supports both languages, with Bulgarian as the default and English available for international clients.

contact.copy: The form is built for serious inquiries, while quick actions stay available for phone, Viber, WhatsApp, and email.
contact.location: Based in Bulgaria. Travel available depending on the project.
